original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-pullback-property-local-target}
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, \etale, Zariski\}$.
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms which is $\tau$ local
on the target. Let $f : X \to Y$ have property $\mathcal{P}$.
For any morphism $Y' \to Y$ which is
flat, resp.\ flat and locally of finite presentation, resp.\ syntomic,
resp.\ \'etale, resp.\ an open immersion, the base change
$f' : Y' \times_Y X \to Y'$ of $f$ has property $\mathcal{P}$.

final_content.statement: A property $\mathcal P$ of scheme morphisms is *local on the target for the $\tau$-topology* if for every $\tau$-covering $\{Y_i\to Y\}$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$ if and only if each base-changed morphism $f_i:X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ has $\mathcal P$. Let $\tau$ be one of fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, étale, or Zariski, and let $\mathcal P$ be $\tau$-local on the target. If $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$, then its base change along any $g:Y'\to Y$ belonging to the corresponding class of maps—flat for fpqc; flat locally finitely presented for fppf; syntomic for syntomic; smooth for smooth; étale for étale; and an open immersion for Zariski—also has $\mathcal P$.
hypotheses: P is tau-local on the target; f has P; g belongs to the indicated class for tau.
conclusions: The base change f':X×_Y Y'→Y' has P.
